text:
Mia: Quick check — planning to roll the users table schema change tomorrow. Who's owning the deploy and what time window do we want for the dual-write + backfill? Need to coordinate smoke checks + rollback readiness.
Devon: I can own the deploy. proposing 03:00 UTC window (low traffic) for schema cut + dual-write. Backfill to run afterwards on a separate job.
Sasha: 03:00 UTC works for me. How long do we expect the backfill to take? If it's >2h we should stagger.
Kevin: Backfill estimate depends on range. For the shard we'll be doing ~120M rows, previous run suggested ~5h on a full node. But with batching and parallel workers we can target ~2.5h. Will need to cap workers to avoid CPU spike.
Mia: Good call. Let's plan for: 03:00 UTC schema cut + dual-write enabled, 03:30 start canary backfill on a single shard, then scale after 04:00 if metrics look good. Rollback plan: toggle dual-write off + deploy old schema back if we see >1% 5xx or replication lag >120s.
Devon: Adding smoke checks — will run these post-cut (runbook snippet):
```
-- smoke queries
SELECT count(1) FROM users WHERE schema_version = 'v2' LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(1) FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users LIMIT 10);
-- latency check: p99 < 200ms for read path
```
If smoke queries fail, we rollback immediately.
Sasha: Can we add a quick canary traffic rule? I can route 2% of auth traffic to the new path for the first 15m. Helps catch edge cases.
Devon: Yep. I'll add a routing flag in the feature-gate service and document the toggle.
Kevin: Also watch replica lag and compaction on the writable replicas. I'll keep an eye on binlog positions and run `pg_replication_status` every 5m for the first hour.
Mia: I pushed a short runbook (link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/users-schema-rollout) — please read. Key reminders: DB backups before cut, slow query monitor enabled, ops contact list.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window set for 1812414800 (03:00 UTC tomorrow). Notifying on-call.
Sasha: Ping for code review — @devon could you add the dual-write toggle into the PR? I left comments on the migration script.
Devon: On it. Will address CR comments today and mark ready by EOD.
Mia: Final checklist for tomorrow: backups ok (Kevin), PR merged + toggle in place (Devon), canary routing ready (Sasha), runbook acknowledged (everyone). If we hit >1% errors or p99 spikes, immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Backups scheduled in 30m, I'll post confirmation once snapshot completes.
Mia: Thanks — will post a short reminder an hour before window.
